standard: Which tools the estate's agent surfaces install, at which version, and from where. Declared once here (ADR-0020 section 2); each surface keeps its native installer and CI asserts the installers agree with this file.
read_from: tests/tool-manifest.py asserts every bootstrap_var below equals the literal in cloud/bootstrap.sh. Nothing reads it at runtime: the bootstrap must keep working when this file cannot be fetched.

surfaces.ubuntu-durable: OS=ubuntu, persistence=durable: Linux and WSL workstations. Installer: dotfiles' apt data.
surfaces.ubuntu-ephemeral: OS=ubuntu, persistence=ephemeral: every cloud sandbox. Installer: cloud/bootstrap.sh.

unrecorded_surfaces_why: macos and ubuntu-durable are installed by pmgledhill102/dotfiles. Their arms are declared by that repo against this file, via the issues this change files there; this file does not assert what dotfiles currently installs.

on_failure_values.degraded: The capability runs in a subshell, a failure is recorded as status=degraded in ~/.agents/.bootstrap-manifest, and the run continues (ADR-0020 section 2).

tools.name: shellcheck
tools.why: The shellcheck binary the repo's local hook runs; Ubuntu's package is 0.9.0, so a pinned release keeps the CLI and the hook on one version.

tools.name: actionlint
tools.why: Not packaged in Ubuntu. Same rev as the actionlint-system hook in cloud/precommit-warm.yaml.

tools.name: gitleaks
tools.why: The gitleaks-system hook needs 8.19 or later and avoids a ~30s source build on a cold cache.

tools.name: markdownlint-cli2
tools.why: CI parity: the version the markdownlint hook pins.

tools.name: terraform
tools.why: One version for CI and the sandbox. The pin is owned by the repo-settings spec, which also holds the floor and the sweep rules, so the manifest points at it rather than copying it.

tools.name: tflint
tools.why: Terraform lint for repos with *.tf files.

tools.name: tflint-ruleset-google
tools.why: The Google ruleset plugin for tflint.

tools.name: gh
tools.why: The GitHub CLI, used for REST reads where the MCP server lacks a call.

tools.name: golangci-lint
tools.why: The image's copy is built with an older Go and refuses newer modules, so it is replaced in place.

tools.name: semgrep
tools.unpinned_why: Installed from PyPI at latest; the repo's own hook pins its rev. A version pin belongs here once CI parity needs one.
tools.if_absent: The pre-commit hook reports semgrep as NOT CHECKED, never as passed (#335).

tools.name: checkov
tools.if_absent: Reported NOT CHECKED, never as passed.

tools.name: pre-commit
tools.unpinned_why: The framework; each hook pins its own rev.

not_installed.name: hadolint
not_installed.why: Wanted for Dockerfile lint; tracked in #692 and #680.

not_installed.name: trivy
not_installed.why: Wanted for image scan; tracked in #680.

exclusion_rule: A tool left off a surface on weight grounds is listed in not_installed with its reason. The consumer must keep reporting it as NOT CHECKED rather than treating absence as a pass.
